technical_quality: Adequate PA film of a young patient; good inspiration (posterior ribs ~9-10 visible), no significant rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration with thoracic spine faintly visible through the mediastinum. Left side marker (L) present at image top-right, confirming conventional orientation. Minor cropping of the lateral soft tissues of the left chest wall, lung fields fully included.

devices.type: External side marker (L) with adjacent round radiopaque marker disc
devices.location: Top-right corner of the image, lateral to the patient's left shoulder / acromioclavicular region (patient's left side, outside the thorax)

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光：兩側肺野透亮度對稱且清晰，未見實質浸潤、結節、腫塊或肋膜積液，肺紋理分布正常。心臟大小及縱膈輪廓正常，氣管居中，兩側橫膈平滑，肋膈角銳利，左橫膈下可見正常胃泡。骨骼結構未見骨折或破壞。影像右上角（病人左肩外側）可見 L 側別標記及圓形不透光標記物，屬外在物件；未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或其他治療相關裝置。整體判讀為無急性心肺異常。
